# Which part of Files/install.dos installs each file of the kit (the Installer's
# update copies a changed file again and runs its part again; tools/mkmanifest.py
# writes the part into Files/MANIFEST). One line: <part> <kit path> [<UP-Term: drawer>]
# A kit path names a file or a whole drawer; the longest one that matches wins.
# "-": in the kit, not installed. The third column: a copy part's drawer in UP-Term:
# (what P_COPY's copyfiles and install.dos's copy-<part> copy it to).
# Every file of the kit must match a line: mkmanifest stops `make dist` otherwise.
-               Install
-               Install.info
-               Uninstall
-               Uninstall.info
-               README.txt
-               LICENSES.txt
-               ClaudeCode
-               ClaudeCode.info
-               Files/install.dos
